scripts.prisma:generate: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const env = { ...process.env }; if (!env.DATABASE_URL) env.DATABASE_URL = 'file:./dev.db'; const prismaBin = require.resolve('prisma/build/index.js'); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [prismaBin, 'generate', '--schema=./prisma/schema.prisma'], { stdio: 'inherit', env }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
